rows.grounds: compound naming siddhi attainment rooted in Kaula

items.question: Which eightfold siddhi attainment rooted in Kaula is addressed to the fair-faced goddess?
items.inference: The verse names eight siddhis as Kaula-rooted attainment.
uncertainties: Compound token has unresolved internal syntactic role.
items.plain_english: Eight, and the siddhi-attainment rooted in Kaula, O fair-faced one.
